gloss: neglect of one's health; unhealthy living

definitions.gloss: neglect of one's health; failure to take care of oneself
definitions.explanation: Living in a way that damages your own health — irregular hours, overwork, drinking too much, ignoring a doctor's advice. It is a mild, slightly old-fashioned reproach, often aimed at oneself.

examples.japanese: {不養生|ふようじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たたった。
examples.english: My neglect of my health caught up with me.

examples.japanese: {若|わか}い⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不養生|ふようじょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I regret how badly I looked after myself when I was young.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎晩|まいばん}→毎晩：00967_maiban⟧⟦{夜更|よふ}かし→夜更かし：07693_yofukashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧ようで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{不養生|ふようじょう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: If you stay up late every night and skip breakfast too, you can hardly complain about being told you neglect your health.

notes:
Formed from {不|ふ} (not) plus ⟦{養生|ようじょう}→養生：08636_youjou⟧ (taking care of one's health, convalescing). It names the behavior, not the illness that results.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不養生|ふようじょう}: "the doctor's own bad habits" — a set proverb for someone who preaches what they fail to practice
- {不養生|ふようじょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧たたる: for neglect of one's health to catch up with one
- ⟦{日頃|ひごろ}→日頃：07284_higoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{不養生|ふようじょう}: one's habitual poor self-care

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不摂生|ふせっせい}→不摂生：15502_fusessei⟧: intemperance, unhealthy habits — a near-synonym, slightly more about excess (drink, food)
- ⟦{養生|ようじょう}→養生：08636_youjou⟧: taking care of one's health, resting to recover — the positive counterpart
